Damage / Effect
Cold

You snap-freeze a target in range, dealing cold damage and slowing its movement.

The target has disadvantage on its next Dexterity saving throw before the end of your next turn.

At Higher Levels. The cold damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 1st.

Frozen Vulnerability

Primed targets take additional damage from the next detonation.

Radius Burst

The power can affect creatures within 5 feet of the target.
